title: Demo: retry jitter, shouldRetry, injectable clock
head: __HEAD__
summary:
- Intent: add jitter and a shouldRetry predicate; make the bucket clock injectable.
- Blocker: retry makes one attempt more than maxAttempts.
- The test was bumped to match the bug instead of catching it.
- Bucket refill can starve fast pollers; depends on caller rates.

checked: ran `bun test`: 3 pass, including the 5-call expectation
fake-clock repro: bucket(1, 5/s) polled every 100ms acquires 0 tokens in 2s
sleep.ts to delay.ts: pure rename, one identifier changed
unchecked: callers of TokenBucket and their polling rates; none in this repo

tracks.title: Retry attempts and backoff
tracks.summary:
- RetryOptions renames retries to maxAttempts and changes its meaning.
- The loop kept the old bound; see [[attempt-loop]].
- The test pins the extra attempt; see [[attempts-test]].
- Jitter feeds the bucket risk in track 2; see [[full-jitter]].

stops.title: maxAttempts now counts the first attempt
stops.body:
- Old field: retries after the first attempt (default 3).
- New field: total attempts, first included (default 4).
- Same total for defaults; the loop must change with it.
stops.ask: Is renaming the field enough warning for callers that set retries?

stops.title: Loop bound is off by one
stops.body:
- `attempt <= maxAttempts` runs maxAttempts + 1 times.
- Bound was right for the old meaning; see [[retry-options]].
- Default config now makes 5 calls, not 4.
- Fix: `attempt < maxAttempts`, delay while `attempt < maxAttempts - 1`.
stops.ask: Block on this, and is the proposed fix right?

stops.title: Test expectation moved from 4 to 5
stops.body:
- Test passes maxAttempts: 4 and now expects 5 calls.
- Pins the bug instead of catching it; see [[attempt-loop]].
stops.ask: Should this assert 4 calls once the loop is fixed?

stops.title: Full jitter on by default
stops.body:
- Delay is uniform in [0, capped); can be near zero.
- On by default, so every existing caller changes timing.
- Spreads load well but shortens the average wait by half.
stops.ask: Should jitter default on, or start at half jitter?

tracks.title: Token bucket clock
tracks.summary:
- The clock is now injectable; defaults keep Date.now.
- Refills round down and drop the remainder; see [[refill-floor]].
- Jittered retries make fast polling likelier; see [[full-jitter]].

stops.title: Injectable clock in the constructor
stops.body:
- New optional third argument `now`, default Date.now.
- lastRefill now starts from the injected clock.
- Enables the starvation repro; see [[refill-floor]].
stops.ask: Confirm Date.now as a detached default is safe here.

stops.title: Refill floors tokens and resets the timer
stops.body:
- Math.floor drops fractional tokens, then lastRefill resets.
- Polling faster than one token interval never refills.
- Fake clock: 5/s bucket polled every 100ms got 0 tokens.
- Jittered retries can poll that fast; see [[full-jitter]].
stops.ask: Does any caller poll faster than one token interval?

skipped.reason: Adds delay and Clock re-exports; no logic.
